title: How to use OpenAI Subscription/Codex as provider for MAF

cues.en: Hi, and welcome to this AI and C-Sharp video on two of my favorite topics.
cues.zh: 大家好，這支 C# AI 影片要介紹我最喜歡的兩個主題。

cues.en: One being Microsoft Agent Framework, but the other one being Codex, the coding agent from OpenAI.
cues.zh: 一個是 Microsoft Agent Framework，另一個是 OpenAI 的程式開發代理程式 Codex。

cues.en: And in this video, I'm going to show you how I've made a NuGet package that you can actually combine them to use Microsoft Agent Framework with Codex.
cues.zh: 這次會示範我製作的 NuGet 套件，如何結合兩者，讓 Microsoft Agent Framework 使用 Codex。

cues.en: So you don't need any API key or tokens, you can simply use your OpenAI description instead.
cues.zh: 因此不需要另外提供 API 金鑰或購買 Token，直接使用 OpenAI 訂閱即可。

cues.en: So what I have here is a sample repo, there's links in the description to it.
cues.zh: 這裡有一份範例儲存庫，連結放在影片說明中。

cues.en: And I'm going to first try and do it without having any code up front.
cues.zh: 我會先從沒有預先寫好程式碼的情況開始，

cues.en: And then I'm going to show you the full set of features that the system can do.
cues.zh: 再示範這個系統支援的完整功能。

cues.en: But before we can do this, you need to be sure that you have the Codex CLI installed.
cues.zh: 但開始之前，必須先確認已安裝 Codex CLI。

cues.en: It's not like you need to use the Codex CLI, it just needs to be installed.
cues.zh: 不需要平常都透過 CLI 操作，只要安裝即可。

cues.en: So if you can write Codex, and it starts, you are good to go.
cues.zh: 如果輸入 codex 能啟動，就符合條件。

cues.en: If it's logged in, in my case, I've logged in using my OpenAI subscription.
cues.zh: 當然也要登入；我這裡使用自己的 OpenAI 訂閱登入。

cues.en: But if you don't have that installed, you can write npm install slash g OpenAI slash Codex to get installed.
cues.zh: 如果尚未安裝，可以執行 npm install -g @openai/codex。

cues.en: Then you run it for the first time, it will guide you to log in with your credentials.
cues.zh: 第一次執行時，它會引導你使用帳號登入。

cues.en: And it can be any paid subscription you have from OpenAI.
cues.zh: 可以使用你的 OpenAI 付費訂閱。

cues.en: And then you should be ready to go.
cues.zh: 完成後就能開始。

cues.en: So we don't really need Codex, other than having it in here, because there will be an executable that we can leverage.
cues.zh: 我們只需要 CLI 安裝後提供的執行檔，實際上不必透過 CLI 介面操作。

cues.en: The next thing we need to do is we need to install a NuGet package.
cues.zh: 接著安裝 NuGet 套件。

cues.en: And this is not something that the agent framework themselves have delivered, but something I have built.
cues.zh: 這不是 Agent Framework 團隊提供的套件，而是我自己建立的。

cues.en: So I built an agent framework toolkits, which you might have heard about before.
cues.zh: 我之前做了 Agent Framework Toolkit，你可能聽過。

cues.en: But there's a new Codex NuGet version of it as well.
cues.zh: 現在又新增 Codex 版本的 NuGet 套件。

cues.en: So if we install this, and we go down here, we can now make something called a Codex agent factory.
cues.zh: 安裝後，就能在這裡建立 CodexAgentFactory。

cues.en: We can give connections and stuff, but out of the box, we don't really need to do anything more than that.
cues.zh: 可以提供連線設定，但一般情況下不需要額外指定任何內容。

cues.en: We just need to get a factory here.
cues.zh: 只要先取得 Factory。

cues.en: And as you can see, I have made them experimental at the moment, because this is brand new, and I want to be able to make breaking changes if need be.
cues.zh: 目前我把它標記為實驗性功能，因為這是全新的實作，希望必要時仍能進行重大變更。

cues.en: I have not found anything yet that needs to, but just like the responses API from OpenAI is in preview, so is this, so you simply need to go in
cues.zh: 目前還沒遇到必須修改的地方，但就像 OpenAI 的 Responses API 仍有預覽功能，這裡也一樣，因此需要，

cues.en: and make a pragma warning disable in order to get rid of that.
cues.zh: 加入 pragma warning disable，關閉這項警告。

cues.en: Once we have our agents, we can simply just say create agents, and we can do that either using some options or just giving a working directory,
cues.zh: 有了 Factory，就能呼叫 CreateAgent；可以提供完整選項，也可以只提供工作目錄，

cues.en: because whenever you work with Codex, you need to give it a folder that it's working upon.
cues.zh: 因為使用 Codex 時，必須指定它要在哪個資料夾工作。

cues.en: So whenever you go to the CLI, it will be the folder that you start processing.
cues.zh: 在 CLI 中，就是啟動它時所在的資料夾。

cues.en: If you're in the Codex app, it's whatever project you have set it on to be.
cues.zh: 在 Codex App 裡，則是目前設定的專案目錄。

cues.en: But in our case here, we will just say environment.currentDirectory.
cues.zh: 這裡直接使用 Environment.CurrentDirectory。

cues.en: So we'll just work there, but it could be any that we want.
cues.zh: 也就是目前目錄，當然也可以指定其他目錄。

cues.en: And then we get an agent, and that agent can do the same things that we can do in normal agent framework.
cues.zh: 接著就能取得代理程式，使用方式和一般 Agent Framework 相同。

cues.en: So we can say awaits agent.runAsync.
cues.zh: 例如 await agent.RunAsync。

cues.en: What is the capital?
cues.zh: 問：「首都是哪裡？」

cues.en: France.
cues.zh: 具體來說，是法國。

cues.en: And as you can see, it's exactly the same system as a normal agent framework, but agent response is runAsync.
cues.zh: 如你所見，這和一般 Agent Framework 完全相同，RunAsync 一樣回傳 AgentResponse。

cues.en: Codex agent here can actually also just be an AI agent.
cues.zh: 這裡的 CodexAgent 也能直接當作 AIAgent 使用。

cues.en: It will understand that.
cues.zh: 型別系統可以接受。

cues.en: And we can just say console.writelineResponse1.
cues.zh: 再用 Console.WriteLine 輸出 response1。

cues.en: Another thing we can do is, of course, work with structured output.
cues.zh: 另外當然也能使用結構化輸出。

cues.en: So we can go in and say agent.runAsync.
cues.zh: 同樣呼叫 agent.RunAsync。

cues.en: In this case, I've made a little movie down here.
cues.zh: 我在下方先定義了一個 Movie 型別。

cues.en: So let's get a movie back, and let's get the top movie according to IMDb.
cues.zh: 要求回傳 IMDb 排名最高的電影，並轉成 Movie。

cues.en: Let's take the right name.
cues.zh: 先改成正確的名稱。

cues.en: Let's make that response number two.
cues.zh: 這筆命名為 response2。

cues.en: And let's say console.writelineResponse2.result.title.
cues.zh: 接著輸出 response2.Result.Title。

cues.en: And console.writelineResponse2.result.yearRelease.
cues.zh: 以及 response2.Result.YearRelease。

cues.en: So we can do normal responses.
cues.zh: 所以能取得一般回覆，

cues.en: We can do structured output.
cues.zh: 也能取得結構化輸出。

cues.en: And of course, at the end, we can do agent.runStreamingAsync to make soup.
cues.zh: 最後，當然也能用 agent.RunStreamingAsync 進行串流。

cues.en: And that's not an await here, but it's just an await for each.
cues.zh: 這裡不是直接 await，而是使用 await foreach。

cues.en: We did get an update back, and we say console.writelineResponse1. Update.
cues.zh: 每次取得 update，再用 Console.Write 輸出更新內容。

cues.en: So everything is like we normally do.
cues.zh: 所以用法和往常一樣。

cues.en: Everything here is exactly the same.
cues.zh: 這裡所有操作都完全相同。

cues.en: The only way we did make an agent in a slightly different manner.
cues.zh: 只有建立代理程式的方式稍微不同。

cues.en: And that agent is actually with no credentials, no API keys.
cues.zh: 而這個代理程式不需要另外提供憑證或 API 金鑰。

cues.en: It will use your OpenAI limits, of course.
cues.zh: 當然，它會使用你的 OpenAI 訂閱額度。

cues.en: But beyond that, it will not cost you anything other than your subscription.
cues.zh: 除此之外，不會在訂閱費外另外按 API Token 計費。

cues.en: So if we set this up as the starting project,
cues.zh: 把它設為啟始專案後，

cues.en: then let's try and run it and see how it goes.
cues.zh: 就來執行看看。

cues.en: So first, we ask for the capital of France.
cues.zh: 第一個問題是法國首都。

cues.en: Come back and say it's Paris.
cues.zh: 它回答巴黎。

cues.en: Top movie according to IMDb.
cues.zh: 接著是 IMDb 排名最高的電影，

cues.en: Instructed output.
cues.zh: 以結構化輸出回傳。

cues.en: This shows a redemption from 1994, and the streaming comes back like we normally see streaming do.
cues.zh: 這裡是 1994 年的《刺激1995》，串流部分也像平常一樣逐步輸出。

cues.en: So as you can see here, it's dead simple to use once you have installed and logged in Codec CLI.
cues.zh: 可以看到，安裝並登入 Codex CLI 後，用法非常簡單。

cues.en: And again, you can do this for free, and I put free in quotation mark because you have a subscription.
cues.zh: 也可以說是免費使用，但這裡的免費要加引號，因為你仍然有付訂閱費。

cues.en: You don't use all the limits.
cues.zh: 如果本來就沒有用完額度，

cues.en: It's essentially free.
cues.zh: 相當於不需要額外費用。

cues.en: Of course, if you hit your limits, that's the way it is.
cues.zh: 當然，碰到用量上限時仍然會受到限制。

cues.en: So this is the simple thing.
cues.zh: 這是最簡單的用法。

cues.en: Let's dive a little deeper into what it can actually do.
cues.zh: 接著更深入看看它能做什麼。

cues.en: So I have a different sample up here, because again, this comes from my NuGet package collection called Agent Framework Toolkit,
cues.zh: 上方還有另一個範例；同樣來自我的 Agent Framework Toolkit NuGet 套件系列，

cues.en: which is just this way of using other providers and using the providers we know already in a modern way.
cues.zh: 用更方便的方式整合其他供應商，以及我們已經熟悉的供應商。

cues.en: So let's get rid of this and go back up here instead.
cues.zh: 先把這個關掉，回到上方。

cues.en: Here I'm doing exactly the same.
cues.zh: 這裡同樣採用相同流程。

cues.en: I have access to the NuGet package, and that's it.
cues.zh: 只需要參照這個 NuGet 套件。

cues.en: So let's have a look at what's going on here.
cues.zh: 接著看看程式碼。

cues.en: So let's run it, and we will take it line by line.
cues.zh: 我們執行一次，逐行說明。

cues.en: So first up, or first down, so first up, or let's actually do it like this, so it's a little easier for you to see.
cues.zh: 首先……先把視窗調整成這樣，會比較容易看。

cues.en: So we could make a factory, but I mentioned we could make a connection up here.
cues.zh: 可以直接建立 Factory，但剛才也提到能提供連線設定。

cues.en: It is optional because in 99% of cases, you would not need to do anything special here.
cues.zh: 這是選填，因為百分之九十九的情況不需要特殊設定。

cues.en: But it is possible if you have an advanced or installed codecs in a special way that it might be needing to tell where the executable is,
cues.zh: 如果 Codex 用比較特殊的方式安裝，可能需要明確指定執行檔位置，

cues.en: else it will just pick it up from the path.
cues.zh: 否則會直接從 PATH 找到它。

cues.en: It could be that you want to have your codecs home credential where you have the different configurations and stuff in a different path.
cues.zh: 也可能想把 Codex Home，也就是保存憑證與各種設定的目錄，改成其他位置。

cues.en: You can set that here.
cues.zh: 這裡可以設定。

cues.en: You can go in and use endpoint and API key in order to use codecs with a third-party tool
cues.zh: 也能指定端點與 API 金鑰，讓 Codex 使用第三方供應商，

cues.en: or use OpenAI's tokens instead of your subscription.
cues.zh: 或改用 OpenAI API Token，而不是訂閱額度。

cues.en: And there's a few more things here, environment variables and some more advanced stuff that you in 99% of time
cues.zh: 還有環境變數等進階選項，但百分之九十九的情況，

cues.en: probably will never ever need.
cues.zh: 可能都不會需要。

cues.en: So in most cases, you actually don't need to set anything in a codecs connection, but it is possible.
cues.zh: 因此多數時候不必設定 CodexConnection，不過有需要時仍然做得到。

cues.en: Then I mentioned that we need to be in a folder, meaning a working directory.
cues.zh: 接著，剛才說必須有工作目錄。

cues.en: So in this case, I've made a working directory here, have an agent's MD, because whenever you put in these working directories, it will pick up whatever agents MD and skills you have in this.
cues.zh: 我在這裡建立了一個工作資料夾，裡面有 AGENTS.md；Codex 會讀取工作目錄裡的 AGENTS.md 與技能。

cues.en: In this case, I have a small agent's MD, and let's just have it speak like a pilot.
cues.zh: 這裡的 AGENTS.md 很簡單，只要求它像海盜一樣說話。

cues.en: Something like that.
cues.zh: 類似這樣。

cues.en: But of course, in real life, you will put any kinds of things in your agent's MD that this agent will begin to pick up.
cues.zh: 實際應用當然可以在 AGENTS.md 放入各種規則，代理程式會讀取它們。

cues.en: So if we go back to the codecs connection, we can see that we have a working directory here.
cues.zh: 回到這裡，可以看到我們有指定工作目錄，

cues.en: We have a working directory here, and we have a working directory here.
cues.zh: 其他範例也都有各自的工作目錄。

cues.en: So if we have a look at that, we just create that path here, and then we can create our agents.
cues.zh: 先建立這個路徑，再建立代理程式。

cues.en: And when we did it the first time, we just gave a working directory.
cues.zh: 第一次示範只提供了工作目錄。

cues.en: But if we want to be more advanced on what that agent does, we said we use a codecs agent options.
cues.zh: 如果想進一步控制代理程式行為，就使用 CodexAgentOptions。

cues.en: So it has a bunch of settings.
cues.zh: 它有許多設定。

cues.en: The first one, of course, being the mandatory working directory.
cues.zh: 第一個當然是必填的工作目錄。

cues.en: Then you can choose what model to use, just like you can in codecs.
cues.zh: 接著能像 Codex 一樣選擇模型。

cues.en: So the models in codecs are also available in this, and you can set your reasoning efforts.
cues.zh: Codex 可用的模型，這裡也能使用，並可設定推理強度。

cues.en: And by the way, we can also set the service tier if you want to run fast mode or have a $500 subscription and want to run ultra-fast.
cues.zh: 另外也能設定 ServiceTier，例如快速模式，或有較高階訂閱時使用超快速模式。

cues.en: In my case, I normally just run normal mode.
cues.zh: 我自己通常使用一般模式。

cues.en: You can see that I have a lot of options here.
cues.zh: 可以看到，這裡有很多選項。

cues.en: You can set the permissions, just like you can in codecs as well.
cues.zh: 也可以像 Codex 一樣設定權限。

cues.en: So what I'm talking about here, if we just bring over codecs in one second.
cues.zh: 我說的是這些選項，先把 Codex 視窗移過來。

cues.en: Here we come.
cues.zh: 好了。

cues.en: So here I have my codecs.
cues.zh: 這裡就是我的 Codex。

cues.en: And what you will also see is that the different things we asked for here is actually in codecs.
cues.zh: 你也會發現，剛才在程式裡提出的問題，實際上也會出現在 Codex 裡。

cues.en: So the threads are being picked up and end up in this reason area because they're not part of a project, in my case here.
cues.zh: 這些對話會被建立出來；我這裡沒有對應到專案，所以會放在最近的對話區域。

cues.en: So these will come along and be there.
cues.zh: 它們會一直保留在那裡。

cues.en: That can be a little annoying, but I haven't found a way to actually hide them from codecs because it is codecs running them, it is making threads.
cues.zh: 這可能有點煩，但目前找不到把它們隱藏的方法，因為確實是 Codex 在執行並建立對話。

cues.en: I guess we could begin to build in that it could delete them after the fact.
cues.zh: 也許之後可以加上完成後刪除的機制。

cues.en: But as of this moment, they're just staying in here and you could continue them if you wanted to.
cues.zh: 但目前它們都會留著，而且你可以繼續接著聊。

cues.en: But the things I'm talking about is, of course, full access and the different settings in terms of what we are going to do here.
cues.zh: 剛才說的權限，就是這裡的完整存取權，以及各種執行設定。

cues.en: So that's what we can place.
cues.zh: 這些都能在選項中指定。

cues.en: We can set the permissions to be only full access or workspace right.
cues.zh: 可以設定 Full Access，或 Workspace Write。

cues.en: So we can write in the workspace but not other places.
cues.zh: 後者允許寫入工作目錄，但不能寫入其他地方。

cues.en: And the approval is, should we ask for approvals or should it never ask for any approvals?
cues.zh: 核准設定則決定要不要詢問許可，或永遠不要求核准。

cues.en: I tend to go to full access and never, but the defaults are these two.
cues.zh: 我通常用完整存取權加上 Never，但預設是畫面上的這兩項。

cues.en: If you don't have an agent empty, you can also send an additional instructions here if need be.
cues.zh: 如果沒有 AGENTS.md，也能在這裡提供 AdditionalInstructions。

cues.en: And then a very cool thing is that you can actually use real.net tools like an agent framework, and they can still be executed by codecs
cues.zh: 還有一點很實用：可以像一般 Agent Framework 一樣提供真正的 .NET 工具，並讓 Codex 執行，

cues.en: by giving in a set of tools just like you normally do.
cues.zh: 只要像平常一樣傳入工具清單。

cues.en: Then codecs have an ability to ask questions, not just in replies back, but in a upfront prompt.
cues.zh: 另外，Codex 能透過專門的互動介面提問，而不只是在回覆文字裡問問題。

cues.en: That is need to be handled in some code down here.
cues.zh: 這需要下方的程式碼來處理。

cues.en: I won't go too much into it, but it will simply just throw up some questions.
cues.zh: 這裡不會太深入，基本上就是把問題顯示出來，

cues.en: You can ask them and then it can submit those answers back to codecs, and it can continue to work.
cues.zh: 取得使用者答案，再把答案送回 Codex，讓它繼續工作。

cues.en: And if you want to keep along on what is actually happening in codecs, when does the run start, when does it end, what does it think, what tools are being called and so on,
cues.zh: 如果想追蹤 Codex 實際做了什麼，例如何時開始、何時結束、在想什麼、呼叫哪些工具，

cues.en: you can get all that information out of a codecs run event that have different kinds and different commands and so on.
cues.zh: 可以透過 CodexRunEvent 取得各種類型與指令的事件。

cues.en: So if you really want to build a real harness out of this, you will leverage these two in order to do that.
cues.zh: 如果要用它建立完整 Harness，就會需要這兩個功能。

cues.en: If you want to have it run more automatic behind the scenes, you will probably not use these and don't use any of the input methods to do that,
cues.zh: 如果只是希望在背景自動執行，可能不會使用這些互動功能，也不會加入輸入處理，

cues.en: get it into full access mode so it can be completely autonomous.
cues.zh: 而是給予完整存取權，讓它完全自主運作。

cues.en: These are the most important ones, but there's a bunch of others like the normal ID name and description, and then all kinds of extra things you can send in.
cues.zh: 這些是最重要的選項；另外還有一般的 ID、Name、Description，以及各種額外設定。

cues.en: If you want to be a local model provider, you can get the tool calling from the C-sharp code and go even deeper into with these thread resume parameters.
cues.zh: 也可以指定本機模型供應商、取得 C# 工具呼叫細節，或透過 ThreadResumeParams 進一步控制。

cues.en: So it's just really, really advanced.
cues.zh: 因此確實能做非常進階的設定。

cues.en: You can go there. You probably don't need to.
cues.zh: 有需要就能深入，但通常用不到。

cues.en: But let's now run a session, because when we do codecs, of course, it runs these chats or threads, depending on the call,
cues.zh: 接著執行 session。Codex 本身有對話或 thread，名稱取決於使用方式，

cues.en: and they're also supported here by using the create session system.
cues.zh: 這裡也透過 CreateSession 提供相同的支援。

cues.en: So if we were to create a session and ask who is Elvis, we will, of course, get an answer back.
cues.zh: 如果建立 session，再問「Elvis 是誰？」，當然會得到答案。

cues.en: And now you can see the first event happened that was run started.
cues.zh: 現在可以看到第一個事件 RunStarted 已經發生。

cues.en: And we got an answer back in pirate speak in this case, but it talks about Elvis.
cues.zh: 它用海盜口吻介紹 Elvis。

cues.en: And now we have a conversation.
cues.zh: 現在我們就有一段對話了。

cues.en: And if we want to, we can say session.getThreadId in order to get the real thread ID over from codecs.
cues.zh: 必要時可以呼叫 session.GetThreadId，取得 Codex 真正的 thread ID。

cues.en: So this will be the same ID as if you find the same thing and say copy the deep link here, which is the thread ID.
cues.zh: 這個 ID 與在 Codex 裡複製深層連結時，連結中的對話 ID 相同。

cues.en: So if we have that thread ID and you save it and so on, we can actually just create a new session to be able to resume to it.
cues.zh: 把這個 thread ID 儲存起來，之後就能建立新 session，繼續原本的對話。

cues.en: So now we are just asking, how tall is he?
cues.zh: 例如現在問：「他有多高？」

cues.en: It knows the first part of it.
cues.zh: 它知道前面談的是誰。

cues.en: So it should be able to actually answer us back, saying that Elvis Presley wasn't this tall.
cues.zh: 所以應該能回答 Elvis Presley 的身高。

cues.en: And now we can also create a new session.
cues.zh: 另外也可以建立全新的 session。

cues.en: So we can say, hey, I'm going to create a new session.
cues.zh: 這裡就重新建立一個。

cues.en: And beyond that, I'm just using a chat loop here.
cues.zh: 接下來只是一般的對話迴圈。

cues.en: So we are going to test various things with file generation, image generation, so on.
cues.zh: 我們會測試建立檔案、產生圖片等各種功能。

cues.en: The only thing I put in here extra is the normal way of doing tool call approval.
cues.zh: 額外加入的只有一般工具呼叫核准機制。

cues.en: So if we will have something that needs our approval, it will pop up and ask for approval here.
cues.zh: 如果某件事需要核准，就會在這裡提出詢問。

cues.en: And also, if any files are changed by the system, it is possible to get back, get files changed, so you can reference those files in a more structured format
cues.zh: 另外，如果系統修改了檔案，也能透過 GetFilesChanged 取得變更清單，以結構化方式參照那些檔案，

cues.en: than just the response.
cues.zh: 不必只依靠文字回覆。

cues.en: So it's a little different here. This is totally normal.
cues.zh: 這裡有一點不同，但都是很一般的處理。

cues.en: And then we had the various extra things up here in order to get the more core events happening.
cues.zh: 上方的額外程式碼，則是用來接收更底層的執行事件。

cues.en: Again, all of this is not needed if you just want to use it as a chatbot.
cues.zh: 再次提醒，如果只當聊天機器人使用，這些都不是必需的。

cues.en: But if you want to build something real with all this bells and whistles around it, you might need all this.
cues.zh: 如果要建立完整的互動系統，才可能需要這些周邊功能。

cues.en: But if we run this, we can try and actually use it as a chatbot.
cues.zh: 現在執行，實際當作聊天機器人試試。

cues.en: So we can, for example, say,
cues.zh: 例如可以說：

cues.en: update agents MD to not speak like a pirate.
cues.zh: 「更新 AGENTS.md，不要再用海盜口吻說話。」

cues.en: So when I was doing a run D, or start to run, they will always come.
cues.zh: 執行開始時，一定會出現對應的 RunStarted 事件。

cues.en: It will come with these mini messages between.
cues.zh: 執行過程中，也會穿插一些短訊息。

cues.en: That's what you normally see in codecs before the real answer is back.
cues.zh: 就是平常 Codex 在正式答案之前顯示的進度訊息。

cues.en: And I'll see it's doing, checking the agents MD.
cues.zh: 現在可以看到，它正在檢查 AGENTS.md。

cues.en: It's making a file change of it.
cues.zh: 並修改這個檔案。

cues.en: And we should be able to see that if we go in here into our agents MD, that it now says we should not speak like a pirate.
cues.zh: 到 AGENTS.md 裡查看，現在應該已經改成不要用海盜口吻。

cues.en: So just as if you could do that with codecs or other coding agents, we can do that.
cues.zh: 所以就像直接使用 Codex 或其他程式開發代理程式一樣，都能完成這些操作。

cues.en: We can also ask what is in this folder.
cues.zh: 也可以問這個資料夾裡有什麼。

cues.en: And we'll just scan the folder and figure out what is in there, find the file.
cues.zh: 它會掃描資料夾、找出裡面的檔案。

cues.en: And we can again see all these messages that are normally tucked away whenever you do codecs.
cues.zh: 同樣能看到這些平常在 Codex 裡可能會收合的進度訊息。

cues.en: We can do whatever codecs can do.
cues.zh: Codex 能做的事情，這裡也都能做。

cues.en: What is the latest space news?
cues.zh: 例如：「最新的太空新聞有哪些？」

cues.en: And because codecs have web searches, it will search the web.
cues.zh: Codex 支援網頁搜尋，所以會上網搜尋。

cues.en: Just like we would have done with the web search tool and responses API.
cues.zh: 就像使用 Responses API 的網頁搜尋工具一樣。

cues.en: And once it's done with all its searches,
cues.zh: 完成所有搜尋後，

cues.en: it will come back with the newest space news as of October 21st, which is the day of this recording.
cues.zh: 會回覆截至 10 月 21 日，也就是這支影片錄製當天的最新太空新聞。

cues.en: We can also use image generation, create an image of a tiger
cues.zh: 也能產生圖片，例如：「建立一張老虎的圖片，

cues.en: and place it in the working directory.
cues.zh: 放到工作目錄中。」

cues.en: It's in the working directory.
cues.zh: 指定放在工作目錄。

cues.en: So now it's using skills and you can see a bunch of things happen.
cues.zh: 現在它開始使用技能，可以看到發生了一連串操作。

cues.en: Now it read the skill to create images that comes out of the box with codecs.
cues.zh: 它讀取了 Codex 內建的圖片生成技能。

cues.en: So again, we get all this more or less for free.
cues.zh: 所以這些能力基本上都能直接取得。

cues.en: And again, had there been skills that I have made, it would have been able to take those.
cues.zh: 如果我另外建立了自己的技能，它同樣也能使用。

cues.en: So sometimes it's a little annoying to get all this message back because it essentially just read the entire skill, the image generation skill.
cues.zh: 有時回傳這麼多訊息會有點煩，因為剛才實際上讀取了完整的圖片生成技能。

cues.en: So in a real chatbot, of course, you wouldn't put out all this or you would collapse it by default like the tools do.
cues.zh: 正式聊天介面當然不會全部攤開顯示，通常會像原本工具一樣預設收合。

cues.en: Now I've made a tiger.png.
cues.zh: 現在已經建立 tiger.png。

cues.en: And if we're lazy, we can say launch it.
cues.zh: 如果懶得自己開，也可以說：「把它打開」。

cues.en: And because of our settings, it should come up and ask, hey, are we allowed to do that?
cues.zh: 因為目前的權限設定，它應該會詢問是否允許。

cues.en: May I open the tiger in the default image viewer?
cues.zh: 「可以用預設圖片檢視器開啟老虎圖片嗎？」

cues.en: Again, if you don't want that, you would simply go in and say, never ask me for approval, and then it would just have opened it.
cues.zh: 如果不希望詢問，就把核准設定改成 Never，之後會直接開啟。

cues.en: Now we need to approve it.
cues.zh: 現在則需要核准。

cues.en: And we do that and our tiger comes up in my default image viewer.
cues.zh: 允許後，老虎圖片就在預設圖片檢視器中開啟了。

cues.en: So there's actually nothing really we can do here.
cues.zh: 所以這裡幾乎沒有什麼特別的限制。

cues.en: We can, of course, say create a random file in the folder.
cues.zh: 當然也可以要求在資料夾建立隨機檔案。

cues.en: And it should create that file in one second.
cues.zh: 它應該很快就會建立。

cues.en: And it did.
cues.zh: 確實建立了。

cues.en: But again, because we have, in this case, workspace rights, it didn't ask us for permission to do it.
cues.zh: 因為這次有 Workspace Write 權限，所以不需要另外詢問。

cues.en: But if we say, create a random file in D colon low,
cues.zh: 但如果要求在 D 槽的另一個資料夾建立隨機檔案，

cues.en: which is just another folder that is not the workspace folder,
cues.zh: 也就是工作目錄以外的位置，

cues.en: it will come and ask us for permission to do that because of the settings we have done.
cues.zh: 它就會根據我們的設定要求核准。

cues.en: And again, in my cases, I would just write this over to never.
cues.zh: 我自己通常會把核准模式改成 Never，

cues.en: And I would give it full access.
cues.zh: 並給予完整存取權，

cues.en: And then it would be able to do all this without any of these requests asking for things.
cues.zh: 就能完成這些工作，不必一直詢問。

cues.en: The final one we have is the questions.
cues.zh: 最後是提問功能。

cues.en: It's a little difficult to get it to show it.
cues.zh: 這個比較難穩定觸發。

cues.en: So use your question feature to let me choose.
cues.zh: 我們要求：「使用你的提問功能，讓我選擇，

cues.en: Between three random colors.
cues.zh: 三個隨機顏色之一。」

cues.en: So if you're using codec, you might know that it sometimes pops up with...
cues.zh: 如果你用過 Codex，可能知道它有時會跳出……

cues.en: Oh, it did it this time.
cues.zh: 這次成功了。

cues.en: Sometimes I can't get it to do it every time.
cues.zh: 有時候無法每次都觸發，

cues.en: It just comes back with text.
cues.zh: 它會直接用文字問。

cues.en: In this case, it actually went down into...
cues.zh: 但這次確實進入了，

cues.en: Let's have it here. This piece of code, it's generated...
cues.zh: 這裡的程式碼，產生了問題。

cues.en: It took two different options, a string concatenate them and showed them between teal, color violet.
cues.zh: 它把選項組合成字串，顯示青綠色、其他顏色與紫羅蘭色等選項。

cues.en: And I can say third one.
cues.zh: 我可以輸入第三個。

cues.en: And then it will send that back and it shows violet in this case.
cues.zh: 然後把答案送回去，這次就是紫羅蘭色。

cues.en: So as you can see, this is quite complicated.
cues.zh: 可以看到，整個系統相當完整，

cues.en: This is quite cool.
cues.zh: 也相當有趣。

cues.en: And again, you don't need to do all this extra thing with the tool approval, extra things out and so on.
cues.zh: 同樣地，不一定要加入工具核准與各種額外輸出。

cues.en: Oh, I haven't showed you that we can call the local weather.
cues.zh: 對了，還沒示範呼叫本機天氣工具。

cues.en: What is the weather in Paris?
cues.zh: 「巴黎的天氣如何？」

cues.en: In real life, it would, of course, be able to do that using web searches and stuff.
cues.zh: 實際上，它當然也能透過網頁搜尋取得。

cues.en: But because we have the tool, it should hopefully call that tool.
cues.zh: 但既然有提供工具，希望它會使用我們的工具。

cues.en: It didn't. It used a web search.
cues.zh: 好像沒有，改用了網頁搜尋。

cues.en: Oh, it called our tool actually.
cues.zh: 喔，其實有呼叫我們的工具。

cues.en: So it's ended up with current weather is sunny and 90 degrees.
cues.zh: 最後回覆目前晴天、19 度。

cues.en: And of course, these things don't use web search, don't do this or so on, should just go into your instructions.
cues.zh: 當然，不要使用網頁搜尋之類的要求，都應該放進指示裡。

cues.en: So as you can see, this is very, very powerful.
cues.zh: 如你所見，這非常強大。

cues.en: The drawback, of course, is that you need to have a Codex CLI.
cues.zh: 缺點是必須安裝 Codex CLI。

cues.en: So this is not good if you need to build a website that is hosted up in Azure, because you can't really install Codex CLI up there
cues.zh: 所以不太適合要部署到 Azure 的網站，因為一般網站主機上不容易安裝 Codex CLI，

cues.en: unless you're on a machine that is a virtual machine.
cues.zh: 除非使用虛擬機器。

cues.en: And even there, you probably wouldn't want to put Codex directly up there.
cues.zh: 即使是虛擬機器，可能也不想直接把 Codex 放到上面。

cues.en: So this is mostly for local tools that you would build onto a Windows machine in order to do this.
cues.zh: 所以主要適合在 Windows 電腦上建立的本機工具。

cues.en: But of course, that can be totally done.
cues.zh: 不過這當然完全可行。

cues.en: I have my finance tool, for example, that does help with my finances.
cues.zh: 例如我有一個協助處理個人財務的工具。

cues.en: And my plan is to switch that over to Codex CLI instead, because I'm essentially not paying tokens.
cues.zh: 我打算把它改成使用 Codex CLI，因為基本上不需要另外按 Token 付費。

cues.en: I'm getting the best models.
cues.zh: 也能使用最好的模型。

cues.en: Yes, it's spending some of my usage down here.
cues.zh: 沒錯，它會消耗下方的訂閱用量，

cues.en: But nothing more than had I asked the same question here.
cues.zh: 但不會比直接在 Codex 問相同問題更多。

cues.en: So it's not like it's taking extra in any way.
cues.zh: 所以不是額外多收一份用量。

cues.en: It's just that we are able to do this in this way in a quite cheap manner for this way to work.
cues.zh: 只是可以透過這個方式，以相對低的額外成本整合到自己的程式。

cues.en: So that is everything.
cues.zh: 以上就是全部內容。

cues.en: Again, grab the NuGet package, agent-framework-toolkit.codex, and you should be able to do the same as what I've just shown you.
cues.zh: 再次提醒，安裝 AgentFrameworkToolkit.Codex NuGet 套件，就能做出剛才示範的功能。

cues.en: So with that, thank you for attending.
cues.zh: 謝謝你收看。

cues.en: See you in the next one.
cues.zh: 我們下支影片見。
